versions.content: Access to specific data is implemented by means of aggre- gating the meta-class VariableAccess in specific roles Please note that from the formal point of view access to specific data is implemented by means of aggregating the meta-class VariableAccess in specific roles. This means that dataReadAccess for a read-access while the write-access is defined by means of aggregating VariableAccess in the role dataWriteAccess .
